title: Release note triage & audience pipeline for tiered launch communications
creator: Aisha Malik
description:
Goal: Replace ad-hoc release note drafts with a repeatable triage + audience pipeline so every launch produces: (1) an internal exec brief, (2) an ops runbook with migration steps, and (3) a customer-facing changelog entry with audience tags and optional migration instructions.

Scope: This ticket builds the review workflow, triage rubric, and signoff matrix (owners + SLAs) for product and infra launches through Q2 2026. It does NOT implement automation for publishing (separate infra task).

Key decisions so far:
- Deliver a single source-of-truth document per launch with audience-scoped sections (Executive, Platform, Integrations, End Customer) rather than maintaining separate docs. Audience tags will be used to render views for each channel (Console, Docs site, Customer Digest). Decision rationale: reduces drift between internal and external messages and simplifies redaction/embargo handling.
- Use a 3-tier triage rubric: Safety/Compliance (P0), Breaking/Upgrade (P1), Info/Quality (P2). Only P0/P1 items require engineering signoff and rollout playbook.
- Embargo window: default 48 hours for enterprise-impacting changes; longer where legal/compliance is required.
- Localization: translations will be required for changes marked "customer-impact: high" and for public docs in EU/APAC regions. We will send a translation batch to vendor as soon as PR is merged.

Outstanding trade-offs and questions:
- Single doc + audience tags may increase initial authoring friction for PMs. Mitigation: provide templates and pre-filled audience sections.
- Automated signoffs vs email/Slack-based approvals. Short term: Slack approvals with a dedicated /release-signoff channel; medium-term: integrate signoff bot (PM-57389).

Artifacts and links:
- Draft triage rubric + template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/launchsop/release-triage-template (Draft v0.2)
- Draft internal exec brief example: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ExecBriefExample
- GitHub PR for the changelog generator prototype: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/128
- Proposed rollout matrix (spreadsheet): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RolloutMatrix

Rollout plan (milestones):
- Feb 20 - Mar 5: Draft rubric, templates, and signoff matrix (COMPLETE)
- Mar 6 - Mar 12: Cross-team review with Eng, Design, Legal, & Sales (IN PROGRESS)
- Mar 13 - Mar 18: Finalize templates + create Slack signoff flow and checklist
- Mar 19 - Mar 25: Pilot with console-2026.03 launch; collect feedback and iterate

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Missing infra edge-cases that require coordinated rollback steps. Mitigation: Engineering owners must attach a one-page rollback plan for P0/P1 items before final signoff.
- Risk: Too many stakeholder comments delaying publication. Mitigation: 48-hour review SLA and explicit "no new content" freeze 12 hours before publish.

Next steps (this ticket):
- Finalize review matrix with named owners and SLAs (action: Jonah)
- Publish the template into Confluence and create a sample filled for console-2026.03 (action: Aisha)
- Kick off pilot signoff thread in #release-signoff and invite cross-functional reviewers (action: Jonah)
